Overview

Amritsar is a city in Punjab with a population of 1,200,000. The spiritual center of Sikhism, home to the Golden Temple, known for its Punjabi culture, delicious cuisine, and historic Jallianwala Bagh. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 10b growing zone supports Hot — tropical and subtropical crops, year-round growing. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
